formula: X + serve(s) as a reminder that + complete clause

formulas.formula: X + serve(s) as a reminder that + complete clause

example: The failure serves as a reminder that preparation matters.
exampleZh: 這次失敗提醒我們，事前準備十分重要。

examples.en: The failure serves as a reminder that preparation matters.
examples.zh: 這次失敗提醒我們，事前準備十分重要。
examples.highlight: The failure serves as a reminder that preparation matters.

rules.zh: 核心表達是 serve as a reminder that 最基本的形式是：【X + serve as a reminder that + clause；The mistake serves as a reminder that details matter.】 這個錯誤提醒我們，細節十分重要。 以下詞語並不是固定句型的一部分：【still；also；clearly；a powerful；to the team；in difficult times】 它們只是按照句意加入的可選延伸。
rules.en: X + serve as a reminder that + clause The mistake serves as a reminder that details matter. still also clearly a powerful to the team in difficult times

rules.zh: 必須配合主語、時態和情態動詞單數主語這宗事件提醒我們，安全最重要。 複數主語這些照片提醒我們，這個城鎮已經改變。 過去式這次延誤提醒我們，時間表安排得太緊密。 情態動詞這宗投訴應該提醒我們，顧客期望得到清晰答覆。 完成式這次經歷提醒了我們，耐性是必要的。
rules.en: serve Singular subject + serves as a reminder that... The incident serves as a reminder that safety comes first. Plural subject + serve as a reminder that... These photographs serve as a reminder that the town has changed. X + served as a reminder that... The delay served as a reminder that the schedule was too tight. X + can / may / could / should / must / will + serve as a reminder that... The complaint should serve as a reminder that customers expect clear answers. X + has / have served as a reminder that... The experience has served as a reminder that patience is necessary.

rules.zh: 形容詞是可選延伸你可以在 reminder 前加入形容詞，說明這項提醒的性質或強度。常見搭配包括：【a clear reminder；a useful reminder；a powerful reminder；a constant reminder；a painful reminder；a gentle reminder；a timely reminder；a lasting reminder】 這宗意外有力地提醒我們，絕不能忽視道路安全。 形容詞不是固定表達的一部分。以下兩句都完整正確：【The accident served as a reminder that road safety matters.】
rules.en: X + serve as a/an + adjective + reminder that... a clear reminder a useful reminder a powerful reminder a constant reminder a painful reminder a gentle reminder a timely reminder a lasting reminder an important reminder The accident served as a powerful reminder that road safety must not be ignored. The accident served as a reminder that road safety matters. The accident served as a powerful reminder that road safety matters.

rules.zh: 可以加入提醒的對象如需清楚指出「提醒誰」，可以在 reminder 後加入：【to + person or group】 完整結構是：【X + serve as a reminder to someone that + clause；The complaint served as a reminder to the team that clear communication matters.】 這宗投訴提醒團隊，清晰溝通十分重要。 比較：【The complaint served as a reminder that clear communication matters.】 這宗投訴提醒人們，清晰溝通十分重要。 這宗投訴提醒團隊，清晰溝通十分重要。 只是指出提醒的對象，並不是固定句型的一部分。
rules.en: to + person or group X + serve as a reminder to someone that + clause The complaint served as a reminder to the team that clear communication matters. The complaint served as a reminder that clear communication matters. The complaint served as a reminder to the team that clear communication matters. to the team

rules.zh: 後面必須接完整子句第二個例子在 that 後面只有名詞片語，並沒有完整的主語和動詞。
rules.en: that that + subject + verb The incident serves as a reminder that everyone must remain alert. The incident serves as a reminder that the importance of safety. ✗

rules.zh: 前通常需要冠詞使用 a 或 an 取決於後面第一個詞的讀音：【a clear reminder；a powerful reminder；an important reminder；an effective reminder】
rules.en: reminder serves as a reminder serves as a useful reminder serves as an important reminder serves as reminder ✗ serves as useful reminder ✗ serves as important reminder ✗ a clear reminder a powerful reminder an important reminder an effective reminder

rules.zh: 目標表達【X】可以有不同形式例句 X：不一定只是簡單名詞。它可以是：。名詞或名詞片語動名詞片語這些不同主語能增加句式變化，避免每句都以簡單名詞開首。
rules.en: X The photograph serves as a reminder that our family has a long history. Losing the account serves as a reminder that passwords must be protected. what-clause What happened yesterday serves as a reminder that rumours can cause harm. the fact that-clause The fact that both teams made the same mistake serves as a reminder that the instructions need improvement. the way-clause The way the volunteers responded serves as a reminder that cooperation matters.

rules.zh: 前置時間、情況或讓步子句是可選延伸核心句型可以出現在句子較後的位置。在困難時期，這本舊日記提醒人們，問題不會永遠持續。 雖然延誤時間很短，但它提醒我們時間表安排得太緊密。 下一個項目開始時，這個錯誤會提醒人們必須清楚分配責任。 前面的時間或讓步部分並不是固定句型的一部分。
rules.en: In difficult times, the old diary serves as a reminder that problems do not last forever. Although the delay was brief, it served as a reminder that the timetable was too tight. When the next project begins, this mistake will serve as a reminder that responsibilities must be assigned clearly.

rules.zh: 在兩個句式中，remind 是及物動詞，通常要明確指出被提醒的人；serve as a reminder 則直接引出提醒的內容，不需要人物受詞。因此前者不可省略受詞，後者也不可誤加同一套動詞結構。
rules.en: remind someone that X + remind + person + that + clause The mistake reminded us that preparation matters. serve as a reminder that X + serve as a reminder + that + clause The mistake served as a reminder that preparation matters. The mistake reminded us that preparation matters. The mistake reminded that preparation matters. ✗

rules.zh: 在相關表達中，可以用名詞 reminder、一般動詞 remind 或其他文法形式帶出提醒，但它們不作本課答案。本課集中使用 serve as a reminder that，並須按主語、時態和情態改變動詞。句中還可加入形容詞、被提醒的人、動名詞主語、名詞子句或句首背景；無論採用哪一種外層句框，that 後仍要接完整子句，核心功能都是由一件事帶出提醒或教訓。
rules.en: X is a reminder that... X reminds someone that... X serves to remind someone that... X is a reminder of + noun As a reminder,... serve as a reminder that 1. Singular subject + serves as a reminder that + clause 2. Plural subject + serve as a reminder that + clause 3. Subject + served as a reminder that + clause 4. Subject + modal verb + serve as a reminder that + clause 5. Subject + has / have served as a reminder that + clause 6. Subject + serve as a/an + adjective + reminder that + clause 7. Subject + serve as a reminder to someone that + clause 8. Gerund phrase + serve as a reminder that + clause 9. What-clause / The fact that-clause + serve as a reminder that + clause 10. Introductory phrase + subject + serve as a reminder that + clause

benefits.zh: 把一件事與更廣泛的道理連起來這個句型不只是描述「發生了甚麼」，還能說明我們應該從事件中記住甚麼。第二句清楚表示「簡報失敗」與「準備十分重要」之間的關係。
benefits.en: It connects an event with a wider lesson Compare: The presentation failed. Preparation is important. The failed presentation serves as a reminder that preparation matters.

benefits.zh: 解釋一件事為甚麼值得注意有些事件本身可能很普通，但這個句型可以指出事件帶來的教訓、警告或啟示。長長的人龍提醒我們，提早到達可以節省時間。 這句不只是描述人龍，也說明我們可以從中學到甚麼。
benefits.en: It explains why an event is meaningful The long queue serves as a reminder that arriving early can save time.

benefits.zh: 把例子和訊息合併成一句你不需要先寫事件，再另外寫一句解釋。這能令兩個相關意思連接得更清楚。
benefits.en: It combines an example and its message Instead of: The file disappeared. We should remember to back up important work. You can write: The fact that the file disappeared serves as a reminder that important work should be backed up.

benefits.zh: 適合反思及議論文章這個句型常用來從一個例子帶出較廣泛的觀點，因此特別適合：作文報告演講新聞評論工作檢討歷史或社會議題討論它能幫助你由「例子」自然過渡到「道理」。
benefits.en: It is useful for reflective and argumentative writing

benefits.zh: 形容詞能調節語氣不同形容詞可以表達不同語氣：溫和提醒實用提醒有力提醒沉痛提醒嚴峻而鮮明的提醒及時提醒這讓你能準確表達事件帶來的感受和重要程度。
benefits.en: Adjectives help control the tone a gentle reminder: a useful reminder: a powerful reminder: a painful reminder: a stark reminder: a timely reminder:

benefits.zh: 提供容易運用的口語框架你可以使用以下框架組織較深入的口語答案：【This experience serves as a reminder that...；What happened serves as a reminder that...；The incident should serve as a reminder that...】 掌握這個框架後，你可以快速加入自己的例子和道理，不需要每次從頭組織整句。
benefits.en: It provides a ready-made speaking frame This experience serves as a reminder that... What happened serves as a reminder that... The incident should serve as a reminder that...
